```{r, message=FALSE}
#| label: Installing-packages
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

```

```{r}
#| label: reading-data

gym_members_data <- read_csv("gym_members_exercise_tracking.csv")

mega_gym_data <- read_csv("megaGymDataset.csv")

head(gym_members_data)
head(mega_gym_data)
```

```{r}
#| label: cleaning-data

units <- names(gym_members_data) |>
  str_extract("\\((.*)\\)") |>  # Extract text inside parentheses
  str_remove_all("[()]")         # Remove parentheses

# Clean column names (remove units and parentheses)
cleaned_names <- names(gym_members_data) |>
  str_replace("\\s*\\(.*\\)", "") |>  # Remove parentheses and their contents
  str_replace_all("\\s+", "_") |>     # Replace spaces with underscores
  tolower()                            # Convert to lowercase

# Create a metadata table
metadata <- data.frame(
  original_name = names(gym_members_data),
  clean_name = cleaned_names,
  units = units,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Apply cleaned names to the dataset
names(gym_members_data) <- cleaned_names

# View the metadata table
print(metadata)
```
